We shipped the feature nobody asked for and it is our best one.

Customers asked for filters. We built a button that says "show me the one I need" and it picks one row. Sometimes it is wrong.

It is used 40 times a day. The filters, which we also built, are used four.

I have stopped asking what people want. I ask what they were doing when they gave up.
